<p align="center"><strong>Find the song that opens the garden exit.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The brass key fits. Beyond the door, a steep-roofed attic smells of cedar and tea.</p>

<p align="center">Three bells hang over a second door: snowflake, sun and leaf. Beside them the ghost has set out two cups.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;The garden is through there,&quot; it says. &quot;But you are very welcome to stay.&quot;</p>
